verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs describe it as a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer, with three documented install paths: Docker Compose (recommended, about five minutes), npm, and a Kubernetes Helm chart. They also cover remote deployment guides and one-click Railway/Zeabur deploys. Community users independently report easy installs and self-hosting it for about a year. Concerns about the acquisition, license changes and local-model support are worries or adjacent questions, not counter-evidence to self-hosting, so they do not affect the verdict.
